events.description: Declaration of a quarterly cash dividend of $0.28 per share payable on June 1, 2010, to shareholders of record as of May 19, 2010.

events.description: Pending maturity and planned repayment of 39.4 billion yen (approximately $423 million) of Samurai notes in July 2010.
events.source_quote: In July 2010, 39.4 billion yen (approximately $423 million using the March 31, 2010, exchange rate) of our Samurai notes will mature. We plan to use existing cash to pay off these notes.

events.description: Recognition of other-than-temporary impairment losses of $41 million ($27 million after-tax) on perpetual securities due to below investment grade downgrades of two issuers.
events.source_quote: During the three-month period ended March 31, 2010, the perpetual securities of two issuers we own were downgraded to below investment grade. ... we recognized other-than-temporary impairment losses for perpetual securities being evaluated under our equity impairment model of $41 million ($27 million after-tax) during the three-month period ended March 31, 2010.
